name: 飞书BOT
tagline: Puts your assistant inside Feishu (Lark) as a DM-able contact.
description: Links an assistant into Feishu, the chat app also called Lark, so it sits in your contacts like a colleague. Send it a private message to research something, draft a document, or kick off a job; the reply lands in that same thread. Setup walks you through registering your own app in Feishu's developer console.
author: tuboshu321
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
